snippet.title: Dylan the Knight Owl
snippet.description:
YO! I’m Dylan the Knight Owl. 

I make videos about weird, interesting, creepy, or cool stuff from around the internet. I also talk about films and video games from time to time. 

I have a couple primary series. 

1. Internet Fables: The series where I go in-depth documentary-style covering an internet figure, drama, or story from start to finish.

2. Horror Explorer: This is the series where I talk about anything and everything horror!

3. Video Game Analysis: This is a series where I talk in depth about video games through the form of long form or multi-part retrospectives.

Come take a seat, get yourself something hot to drink, and enjoy the show.
